original_goal:
[Module: Update Contact Info | TC-012 | Type: Edge/Input | Priority: Medium]
Title: Entering only whitespace into Last Name is treated as missing

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/profile
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "last_name_whitespace": "   "
}

Preconditions:
  User is on the Customer Profile page with the form pre-filled

Steps to Execute:
  1. Clear Last Name and enter only whitespace characters (three spaces)
  2. Click Update Profile

Expected Result:
  Submission is blocked; Last Name is highlighted with inline error indicating the field must be present (whitespace-only counts as empty)

Notes from prior verification:
  Whitespace entry specified explicitly as three spaces. The Last Name field and Update Profile button exist per DOM check; the validation behavior (whitespace-only treated as empty) is runtime and not verifiable from the static DOM.
expected_outcome: Submission is blocked; Last Name is highlighted with inline error indicating the field must be present (whitespace-only counts as empty)
